history_scope: league matches covered in the complete open seasons; domestic cups and European fixtures are not included
date_precision: Calendar dates. Result availability proxy is next UTC midnight; feature cutoff is previous UTC midnight before the target date. Not a claimed exact T-24h archive.
rate_rule: For each side, mix (1-alpha)*mean(historical goals for/opponent goals against) + alpha*mean(historical published xG for/opponent xG against), divided by two across own attack and opposing defense. No target-game xG can enter features.
selection: Choose each target on validation proper score only: log loss for 1X2, Brier for BTTS and Over 2.5; companion score breaks ties.
promotion_gate: Selected variant must improve pooled primary score, not worsen companion score, and improve primary score in each league. Even if passed, status is auxiliary domestic evidence only; no automatic transfer to modern UCL.
limitations: Open xG export/model version and original publication time are not verified as contemporaneously available in 2015/16.
This is one older season in two men's domestic leagues, not a UCL backtest.
All eligible results remain scored; no unlucky exclusions.
